notes: Stuck-generation fix: if the on-device AI ever takes too long to answer, the app now stops that attempt cleanly, tells you, records it in Diagnostics, and moves on - the AI status can no longer stay on GENERATING forever, and later questions are never blocked behind a stuck one. Every answer attempt (finished, failed or timed out) is now recorded in Diagnostics. Everything else is unchanged from v0.9.3 (voice recognition fix, character avatars, AI, Diagnostics).
